title: Associate Engineer, Electronics
jobDescription: The Impact You'll Make As our Senior Designer , you’ll play a key role in supporting electronics hardware product lifecycle activities by ensuring accurate PLM data management, effective component obsolescence tracking, and regulatory compliance coordination. You will help maintain product continuity, improve lifecycle management efficiency, and support compliance readiness across global engineering operations. Through your work, teams across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and compliance will benefit from accurate data, structured processes, and improved operational efficiency. You’ll collaborate with global engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and compliance teams while taking ownership of lifecycle management processes, PLM data maintenance, and obsolescence execution activities, helping us move toward a more efficient and sustainable future. What You’ll Be Doing - Execute and maintain component and product obsolescence management activities for electronics hardware products. - Support PLM lifecycle activities including BOM maintenance, plant extensions, product structure updates, and lifecycle status management. - Collaborate with compliance teams on FMD, PFAS, and environmental/material compliance requirements. - Coordinate with cross-functional global stakeholders to support lifecycle execution, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives. - Contribute to automation and process improvement initiatives to simplify lifecycle and PLM workflows. What We're Looking For - Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, or related technical discipline. - 1 to 7 years of relevant experience in electronics hardware lifecycle management, PLM, or engineering support roles. - Hands-on experience with Electronic BOMs, component lifecycle status management, and engineering change processes. - Familiarity with PLM tools such as Teamcenter, SAP PLM, or equivalent systems. - Exposure to component engineering or obsolescence management will be an added advantage. - Basic understanding of electronics hardware, electronic components, and product structures. - Comfortable collaborating with global cross-functional teams. - Good documentation, reporting, and communication skills. - Positive, open-minded, and persistent attitude with strong interpersonal skills. What You'll Get from Us

title: Senior Professional, BTP Developer
jobDescription: The Impact You'll Make You will help shape how Danfoss delivers digital innovation by building modern, cloud-based solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . Your work will directly support global business processes that enable smarter decisions and seamless user experiences. By developing scalable SAP applications and intuitive Fiori interfaces, you will turn complex requirements into reliable solutions that colleagues across the organization depend on every day. At Danfoss, technology is a key enabler of sustainable growth. In this role, your expertise will strengthen our digital foundation while supporting our long-term ambition to engineer a better, more efficient future. What You’ll Be Doing - Collaborate with IT functional consultants to translate business needs into scalable SAP BTP applications that deliver measurable value. - Design, develop, and deploy cloud applications using RAP and CAPM in SAP Business Application Studio to support enterprise processes. - Build and enhance SAP Fiori applications that deliver intuitive, high-quality user experiences aligned with SAP design standards. - Automate and optimize business workflows using SAP Business Process Automation to improve efficiency and consistency. - Integrate SAP and non-SAP systems securely , ensuring reliable data flow across platforms through modern integration approaches. What We're Looking For - 6+ years of hands-on IT development experience , with a strong focus on SAP technologies and custom application development. - Proven experience developing on SAP BTP , including practical use of RAP and CAPM in real project environments. - Strong expertise in SAP Fiori development , including SAPUI5, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and OData services. - Experience working in SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) to build, test, and deploy cloud-based applications. - Solid understanding of integrations and secure solution design , with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams. What You'll Get from Us You’ll be part of a collaborative and inclusive environment where learning and growth are encouraged. Danfoss offers exposure to global SAP landscapes, opportunities to build deep cloud expertise, and the freedom to explore new technologies. At our Oragadam location, you’ll work with passionate colleagues who value trust, flexibility, and knowledge sharing. Your contributions will be recognized, and your development supported—both technically and professionally. Ready to Make a Difference?

Automate and optimize business workflows using SAP Business Process Automation to improve efficiency and consistency.
Integrate SAP and non-SAP systems securely , ensuring reliable data flow across platforms through modern integration approaches.
6+ years of hands-on IT development experience , with a strong focus on SAP technologies and custom application development.
Proven experience developing on SAP BTP , including practical use of RAP and CAPM in real project environments.
Strong expertise in SAP Fiori development , including SAPUI5, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and OData services.
Experience working in SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) to build, test, and deploy cloud-based applications.
Solid understanding of integrations and secure solution design , with the ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.
